greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu lube nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, usivele inceba.
Kristu, usivele inceba.

homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendiza esemhlabeni, ilinde ukuba amaphiko ayo avuleke, ilinde umzuzu wokuba umoya ovuthuzayo uyiphakamise iye kude apho iliso lomntu lingenakufikelela khona. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyithanda kakhulu loo mbono. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukubukela iinqwelo-moya, indlela awayecinga ngayo nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, encuma kwaye egigitheka xa ethetha ngalo mbono wakhe. Kwakungenguye nje umntwana odlalayo; wayeyindoda encinci eyayibona ububanzi behlabathi, eyayibona ukuba ubomi bunokubhabha kude, bunokufikelela kwiindawo ezintsha, kwaye bunokuba yinto enkulu kunokuba singayicinga apha emhlabeni. UBen wayengumfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu, enqwenela ukubona izinto zihamba kakuhle kwabo bonke abamngqongileyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba sikhangele ngamehlo entliziyo. Uthi: 'Ndikunqulo phambi kukaYise, ukuba aninike ngokobutyebi bozuko lwakhe ukuba nime ngenkani ngamandla ngoMoya wakhe kumntu waphakathi.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Awuthi uThixo wasikhangela kuphela esenza kakuhle. Uthi uKristu uya kuhlala ezintliziyweni zethu ngokukholwa, ukuze nibe neengcambu nisekelwe eluthandweni. UBen wayeyazi le nyaniso ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye. Khumbula umfanekiso kaBen, lowo mntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. Loo mnikelo wawungumfanekiso wothando lukaKristu olungaphezulu kolwazi.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Ndize kuwisa umlilo emhlabeni, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba ububele sele uvutha!' Lo mhlaba ubuthathaka, ubuthathaka phambi kokubandezeleka, ubuthathaka phambi kokulahlekelwa ngumntu omthandayo. UYesu uyazi ukuba ubomi buhlala buphakathi kwemfazano, phakathi kwabathandekayo abahlulwa ngukufa okanye ngemeko yobomi. Kodwa uYesu akazanga ukuba asishiye sodwa kulo mhlaba unomlilo. Uze ukuba asivuthelele ngomoya wakhe, ukuba asomeleze xa iintlungu zisisongela.

Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba ukhumbula uBen kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Ntsikelelo yeSakramente. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwesiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizimanye nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lukaThixo olugqithise ukuqonda konke, kwaye makukhanyise ubuso bakhe phezu kwenu. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lwenkosi apho kungekho ntlungu.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo nabo baphilayo kwintlungu, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingenasiphelo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, ndiguqa phambi kukaYise, ekuthiwa ngaye zonke iintsapho ezulwini nasemhlabeni, ukuba aninike ngokobutyebi bozuko lwakhe ukuba nime ngenkani ngamandla ngoMoya wakhe kumntu waphakathi, ukuba uKristu ahlale ezintliziyweni zenu ngokukholwa; ukuze nibe neengcambu nisekelwe eluthandweni, nibe nako ukuqonda nabo bonke abangcwele ukuba liyintoni na ububanzi, nobude, nobude, nobunzulu, nokwazi uthando lukaKristu olugqithise ukwazi, ukuze nizaliswe ngako konke ukuzala kukaThixo. Ke kuye onako ukwenza ngaphezu kwako konke esikucelayo okanye esikucingayo, ngamandla asebenzayo phakathi kwethu, kuye makubekho uzuko eBandleni nakuKristu Yesu, kuzo zonke izizukulwana, kude kuse ephakadeni. Amen.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi. Thabangani, nina balungileyo, eNkosini; ukudunyiswa ngabathe tye kufanelekile. Bulelani eNkosini ngohadi; yimbeni iindumiso zayo ngohadi olunamalungu alishumi. R. Umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi. Kuba ilizwi leNkosi lithe tye, kwaye yonke imisebenzi yayo ithembekile. Ithanda ubulungisa nokulunga; umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi. R. Umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi. Kodwa icebo leNkosi lime ngonaphakade; ukucinga kwentliziyo yayo, kuzo zonke izizukulwana. Inoyolo isizwe esinguThixo waso yiNkosi, abantu ebazikhethele ilifa layo. R. Umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi. Kodwa amehlo eNkosi aphezu kwabo bayoyikayo, phezu kwabo banethemba ebubele bayo, ukubahlangula ekufeni nokubagcina nasezilambeni. R. Umhlaba uzele bububele beNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Ndize kuwisa umlilo emhlabeni, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba sele uvutha! Kukho ubhaptizo ekufuneka ndibhaptizwe ngalo, kwaye ndixhalabile de lufezeke! Ngaba ucinga ukuba ndize kuzisa uxolo emhlabeni? Hayi, ndithi kuni, kodwa kunoko ukwahlukana. Ukususela ngoku, indlu yabantu abahlanu iya kwahlukana, abathathu ngokuchasene nababini nababini ngokuchasene nabathathu; utata uya kwahlukana nonyana wakhe, unyana noyise, umama nentombi yakhe, intombi nonina, umamazala nomolokazana wakhe, umolokazana nomamazala wakhe.'

day: Thursday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
